verifications.claim: The Artemis program aims to establish a permanent human presence on the Moon to serve as a test bed for technologies necessary for future Mars missions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "pave the way for a lunar landing and, eventually, a Moon base"; "Going to the Moon and staying there for a sustained period is much safer... to be a test bed for learning how to live and work on another planet"; "build on our foundation for the first crewed missions to Mars"; "build an enduring presence, to build a moon base"; "The Moon is the best place for NASA to test new technologies... preparing for future missions to Mars"
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state Artemis aims for a sustained/Moon base presence as a test bed for Mars technologies.
